req_a.text: The BCS shall accept camera scenery information provided by the PCS to brake the vehicle if an object is within the vehicle's path.

req_b.text: The system shall include the Brake Control Subsystem (BCS).

req_a.text: The system shall respond to the surroundings around it in less than 2.5 seconds by dimming the light intensity 50%.

req_b.text: The system shall gradually change the light intensity to ensure a smooth operation for the driver by decreasing the intensity of the light by no greater than 50% in one update.
The system shall verify the source of the update.

req_a.text: If a car in an oncoming lane is within 500 feet of the ADB system, or a car in the same lane is within 250 feet, the subsystem shall decrease light intensity by 50%.

req_b.text: The subsystem shall check for cars and road elements every 10 milliseconds and determine whether the subsystem shall decrease light intensity.

req_a.text: The ADB system shall activate high beams automatically when vehicle speed exceeds 40 km/h and ambient lighting is below 10 lux.

req_b.text: The ADB system shall deactivate high beams within 100 milliseconds upon detecting oncoming headlights or preceding taillights.

req_a.text: The system shall start identifying available parking spots upon user confirmation.

req_b.text: The system shall allow the customer to select an available parking spot displayed through the HMI with a confirm button.

req_a.text: The APA system shall limit maximum vehicle speed to 5 km/h during automated steering and maneuvering.

req_b.text: The system shall request steering control override permission from the primary vehicle domain controller prior to maneuver initiation.

req_a.text: The APA system shall utilize 12 ultrasonic sensors and 4 surround view cameras to calculate target trajectory.

req_b.text: The system shall verify camera lens clarity and ultrasonic transducer health before enabling parking assist.

req_a.text: The system shall resume vehicle motion automatically if the preceding vehicle moves within 3 seconds of stopping.

req_b.text: If the preceding vehicle remains stopped for longer than 3 seconds, the driver must tap the accelerator pedal to resume TJA.

req_a.text: The system shall issue a visual and acoustic driver takeover request if lane markings become indistinguishable for more than 2 seconds.

req_b.text: The lateral control subsystem shall keep the vehicle centered within the detected lane boundaries.

req_a.text: The TJA system shall disengage immediately upon driver brake pedal intervention.

req_b.text: The TJA system shall control longitudinal acceleration and deceleration based on front radar target distance.
